Explore a TUIK SDMX Dataflow before downloading observations

Source: R/explore.R
tuik_explore.Rd

Displays structural components from a Dataflow's DSD without downloading observations. Series dimensions are selected using filters; TIME_PERIOD uses start_period and end_period in tuik_get_data(). A specific coded dimension can be inspected on demand. Codelist entries are theoretical, not necessarily observed in a selected time window.

Usage

tuik_explore(
  dataflow,
  dimension = NULL,
  search = NULL,
  language = c("both", "tr", "en"),
  limit = 50,
  api_key = NULL,
  filters = NULL
)

Arguments

dataflow

A Dataflow ID or a tuik_flow_profile object.

dimension

Optional series dimension ID whose codes to display.

search

Optional search text for dimension codes.

language

One of "both", "tr", or "en".

limit

Maximum codes to display for a selected dimension; default 50.

api_key

Optional API key; defaults to TUIK_SDMX_API_KEY.

filters

Optional named list of selected series-dimension codes. When supplied without dimension, adds selected_codes and filter_status columns to the DSD overview. This reports completeness only; it does not validate Codelist membership or download observations. Pass the same filters to tuik_get_data(), which validates them before retrieval.

Value

Without dimension, a tibble describing DSD components and how to select them. If filters is supplied, also shows selections and missing series dimensions. With dimension, a tibble of Codelist codes and labels.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tuik_explore("DF_TUFE_SDMX_TT01")
tuik_explore("DF_TUFE_SDMX_TT01", dimension = "DEGISIM")
selections <- list(REF_AREA = "TR", FREQ = "M", DEGISIM = "1")
tuik_explore("DF_TUFE_SDMX_TT01", filters = selections)
data <- tuik_get_data("DF_TUFE_SDMX_TT01", filters = selections,
                      filter_mode = "local", start_period = "2026-01",
                      end_period = "2026-01")
} # }
